scope: Read-only capture and independent local zero-work boundary review. No recovery or workload authorization.
review: Read common helpers, full remote capture, local collector and independent boundary reviewer. Original asset/seal verification is read-only; 500 accepted IR files are opaque-hashed before and after. Exact15 selected files, 10 absent native paths plus absent retained namespace, terminal status/prerequisite, canonical binary and owned-process absence are required. Transport bytes and failures are retained; extraction validates unique regular safe members and all hashes. Reviewer verifies source control flow and does not compute effects.
